$comment: Instagram Reels autopost (D444, docs/plan/2026-11-24-instagram-autopost.md). Read by services/posting/instagram.mjs; the Graph API version is pinned here only (every Graph, Facebook Login and rupload URL uses it). scopes: the Facebook Login permissions asked at Connect (business_management added 2026-11-26: a Page owned by a business portfolio is otherwise not listed, so Connect found no Instagram account although one was linked; instagram_manage_insights added 2026-11-26: the Instagram-winners promoter reads each posted Reel's insights (views, reach, watch time, shares, saves) to pick the Reels that go to YouTube; Connect asks again with auth_type=rerequest and Settings says when the saved sign-in lacks it). pollEveryMs / pollMaxMs: how often and how long the Reel container's status_code is asked before giving up for this pass (the job tries again later). redirectHost/redirectPort: the Connect redirect http://<redirectHost>:<redirectPort>/ (Settings > Posting & growth > Instagram shows it); add it as a Valid OAuth Redirect URI in the Meta app. The listener binds the loopback addresses only, 127.0.0.1 and ::1 (review 2026-11-24), so localhost works whichever one the browser picks. Meta allows plain http only for localhost in apps in development mode (UNVERIFIED, checked 2026-11-24). graphVersion: UNVERIFIED as current, checked 2026-11-24. renewDaysBefore: the long-lived token (about 60 days) is exchanged for a new one when fewer days than this are left (at most once a day). retryMinutes: wait after a failed try. stuckContainerMs (2026-11-27): how long one Reel container may stay unfinished (processing or unreadable) before it is dropped and the clip uploaded again, counted as an attempt; a stuck container otherwise blocked the queue for a day. pages_manage_posts added 2026-11-27 (Facebook Live to a Page, services/posting/facebook-live.mjs): a Page live video needs a Page token of a Page admin with pages_manage_posts and pages_read_engagement (Live Video API streaming guide, Broadcast on a Page, checked 2026-11-27); publish_video is for live videos on a user profile only, so it is not asked. All values: agent defaults 2026-11-24, not user instructions.
source: https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/instagram-platform/content-publishing (resumable Reels upload, status_code, media_publish, content_publishing_limit; checked 2026-11-24)
